result.description: A fictional 27-inch environmental display designed for marine-control rooms and weather labs, the Helix Tide Sentry 27 emphasizes wide-angle visibility, anti-glare performance, and durable enclosure materials for long shifts in bright, instrument-heavy spaces. It features a 2560 x 1440 panel, a 144 Hz refresh rate, USB-C input, and a built-in ambient light sensor for adaptive brightness control. The unit is positioned as a professional monitoring monitor rather than a gaming, graphics, or storage device.
